name: Saskatchewan

flag.description: Two horizontal halves, green over gold, with the provincial shield in the upper hoist and a western red lily in the fly.
flag.symbolism: Green stands for the northern forests and gold for the southern grain fields; the western red lily is the provincial flower.

hook: Saskatchewan splits into green forest over golden wheat, with a shield in one corner and a red prairie lily on the other side.
trivia: The design was chosen in a 1969 competition that drew more than 4,000 entries.
Saskatchewan has marked 22 September as its Flag Day since 2017.
